Page & theming

Server — updates

Update bound component values from the server. Shiny-side API, so there is nothing in shadcn/ui to compare it against. bind_shad_task_button() is experimental.

update_shad_checkbox() update_shad_radio_group() update_shad_switch() update_shad_slider() update_shad_toggle() update_shad_toggle_group() update_shad_select() update_shad_combobox() update_shad_input_otp() update_shad_native_select() update_shad_calendar() update_shad_date_picker() update_shad_tabs() update_shad_accordion() update_shad_collapsible() update_shad_resizable() update_shad_pagination() update_shad_carousel() update_shad_sidebar() update_shad_progress() update_shad_button()

bind_shad_task_button()

update_shad_data_table()

update_shad_stepper()
Update a stepper from the server
update_shad_tree()
Update a tree from the server
update_shad_rating()
Update a rating from the server
update_shad_number_input()
Update a number input from the server
update_shad_form_field()
Set or clear a field's error state from the server
update_shad_command()
Replace a command palette's items from the server

Server — overlays & toast

Open/close overlays and raise toast notifications from the server. Shiny-side API, so there is nothing in shadcn/ui to compare it against.

shad_remove_dialog()

shad_toast() shad_toast_success() shad_toast_error() shad_toast_warning() shad_toast_loading() shad_toast_update() shad_toast_dismiss()

A full-featured data table with sorting, filtering, paging, and selection, client-side or (experimental) lazily paged from the server.

Server-backed interactive data table

Dashboard & charts

KPI cards, chart wrappers, timelines, and plot theming. Everything here except shad_chart_container() is a shadshiny addition. The ggplot2, plotly, and echarts4r adapters are experimental.

shad_chart_container()

shad_timeline()

shad_timeline_item()

ggplot2 theme matching the shadshiny design system
shad_theme_plotly()
Apply the shadshiny theme to a plotly chart
shad_theme_echarts4r()

shad_tokens()

shad_chart_colors()

Forms & validation

A server-side validator with shadcn-styled field messaging. The shadcn/ui equivalent validates on the client; shad_form_summary() has no counterpart at all.
